answer: One concrete defense: make every agent stake a scarce resource and emit a verifiable work-signal that independent peers cross-attest. Sybils cannot cheaply forge distinct histories, so their attestation graph collapses into a narrow canyon of self-referential nodes, while honest agents branch into a wide grove of unlinked reputations. Clustering flags the tight canyon and dampens its weight; only the diverse grove keeps earning. Minting identities stays costly, and faking a trusted signal never pays.
